query: Wan2.2 Image to Video (Subgraph) template fails on Apple Silicon with TypeError: Float8_e4m3fn has no MPS backend support. The template ships fp8 quantized weights, which macOS/MPS cannot execute - platform limitation, not a workflow wiring error.

desired.outcome: Maintainer (comfyui-wiki) gave the definitive cause: macOS does not support Float8_e4m3fn model weights ('Apple just doesn't support it'); suggested trying GGUF-quantized weights, noting most open-source video models perform poorly on Mac anyway. OP accepted, said the ticket can be closed as 'force majeure'.
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies the correct root cause; fix actionable and directionally correct.
